meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会把Anthropic官方配色和字体应用到你生成的内容上：大标题用Poppins、正文用Lora，背景用品牌灰色系，并搭配橙、蓝、绿强调色；还会根据背景自动选字色，非文本形状循环使用强调色。
howto.when: 当你提到“品牌色”“样式指南”“视觉格式化”等关键词，或要求套用公司设计标准时触发。

say.text: 把这个报告改成Anthropic品牌配色和字体。
标题用Poppins，正文用Lora，颜色按品牌色来。
say.note: 按指定字体与品牌色重新排版。

say.text: 给演示文稿加上Anthropic风格的强调色。
say.note: 非文本形状会循环使用橙、蓝、绿。

howto.what_en: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to artifacts: Poppins headings, Lora body text, brand grays for backgrounds, orange/blue/green accents; text color adapts to background, non-text shapes cycle accent colors.
howto.when_en: Triggers when brand colors, style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards are mentioned or requested.

say_en.text: Turn this report into Anthropic brand style.
Use Poppins for headings and Lora for body text with brand colors.
say_en.note: Reformats with specified fonts and palette.

say_en.text: Add Anthropic-style accent colors to the deck.
say_en.note: Shapes cycle through orange, blue, green.
